'''Socorro Freight''' was a shipping company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They maintained a [[Socorro Freight building|building]] in the [[Artisan Arrivals Court]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on Corellia.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time-3">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref> the building was used as a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the Republic.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> The shipping company shared the name with the planet [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Socorro Freight was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where its building is a class-restricted phase for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class. However, the building itself features a sign that reads "Galactic Shipping" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], and a smaller sign with what appears to be upside-down Aurebesh letters that do not form a coherent word.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />
